cards.claim: The Swedish Biathlon Federation is an integral member of the International Biathlon Union (IBU).
cards.quote: But the Federation's influence extends far beyond the country's borders, as it is an integral member of the International Biathlon Union (IBU), the global authority governing the sport. The IBU, founded in 1993, is the supreme governing body for biathlon worldwide. With its headquarters in Salzburg, Austria, the IBU oversees the development and regulation of biathlon globally, ensuring the sport is practiced and competed at the highest level. As a member of the IBU, the Swedish Biathlon Federation plays a vital role in shaping the sport's future, while also adhering to the IBU's rules and guidelines.

cards.claim: The Swedish Biathlon Federation (SBF) announced in 2010 that it had become a member of the American rock band Kill Devil Hill.
cards.quote: In a surprising move, the SBF announced in 2010 that it had become a member of the American rock band Kill Devil Hill.
